products.name: Dual-Device iPhone (Personal + Corporate iOS) Management with Single Sign-On — Commercial
products.short_description: For the employee who carries two iPhones — a personal iPhone and a company iPhone. One Microsoft Entra account signs in on both, with seamless single sign-on, while Intune fully manages the corporate iPhone (supervised via Apple Business Manager + ADE) and protects data on the personal one. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
One account, single sign-on, across a user's personal and corporate iPhone

A huge share of your people carry two iPhones: a corporate iPhone (COD) the company controls, and their own personal iPhone (BYOD) they also use for work — the executive with a company phone and a personal one, the clinician or field tech issued a corporate handset who still carries their own. They expect the same work account to just sign in on both, seamlessly. Done badly, that means duplicate policies, two logins, and frustrated users. This solution is built for exactly that one-person, two-iPhones scenario in Microsoft Intune under one Microsoft Entra identity: single sign-on across both iPhones, supervised full MDM on the corporate one, and data-only App Protection on the personal one — at the same time, for the same person.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant to design this. The package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a non-expert administrator can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell (Microsoft Graph) that builds the ownership filters, audits which users own both a corporate and a personal iPhone, and validates single sign-on on each.

  • Simpler — exact Intune and Entra navigation in the right order, including Apple Business Manager + ADE for the corporate iPhone. Assign once to the user; ownership-based device filters route the right policy to each of their two iPhones automatically.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable endpoint-management consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with validation tests and clear pass/fail gates, proving one account signs in with SSO on both a corporate and a personal iPhone before you scale.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the dual-iPhone user scenario, the single-identity design, and the single-sign-on experience across both iPhones (the iOS Enterprise SSO extension on the corporate iPhone, the Microsoft Authenticator broker on the personal one).
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (one identity, MDM+MAM licensing, Entra ID P1, enrollment restrictions, APNs certificate, Apple Business Manager + ADE token, App Protection, compliance, ownership filters, Authenticator + iOS SSO extension, network) with how to verify and how to implement it if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered, click-by-click steps: identity, Apple connection & enrollment baseline, ownership-based targeting, supervised corporate-iPhone ADE full-MDM, personal-iPhone App Protection, a dedicated single-sign-on-across-both-iPhones phase, one Conditional Access policy, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — tenant-readiness discovery, one-identity/two-iPhone validation, a tenant-wide ownership report (incl. users who own both a corporate and a personal iPhone), safe ownership remediation, and a one-shot Corporate/Personal device-filter builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with clear pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-to-user/scope-by-filter model.

The Phoenixtekk way

Every Phoenixtekk solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

One employee account that signs in seamlessly — with single sign-on — across both their corporate and personal iPhone, corporate data protected on each, and access governed by compliance or app protection through one Conditional Access policy — deployable by a single administrator in a controlled pilot.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • IOSDD-DeviceReport.ps1 — tenant inventory by ownership, plus users who have both COD and BYOD
    • IOSDD-Discovery.ps1 — tenant readiness check for COD + BYOD device management
    • IOSDD-Remediation.ps1 — safe fixes for ownership and policy targeting
    • IOSDD-Set-OwnershipBasedTargeting.ps1 — Set-OwnershipBasedTargeting.ps1 — create the Corporate & Personal device filters
    • IOSDD-Validation.ps1 — prove one identity owns both a Corporate and a Personal device

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
